explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the input as a body fragment, then walked tokens with `next_token()`. For each ordinary `#text` token, I checked the decoded text from `get_modifiable_text()` with `str_contains()` and wrapped the token’s normalized serialization from `serialize_token()` in `<mark>`, which preserves normalization and leaves special-element opener text untouched because those are not `#text` nodes.
